evidence: Indexed homepage text presents adjacent navigation labels without clear separators. This is a manual-test lead; keyboard order and focus styling are not confirmed.
user_impact: Keyboard users may lose track of the focused item if order or focus styling is unclear.
recommended_fix: Tab through navigation; verify logical order and visible focus. Save evidence.

evidence: Homepage text extraction lists shipment tracking, mail products, savings schemes and insurance offerings. Individual accessible names and image alternatives require browser inspection.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not understand image-led or generically named service links.
recommended_fix: Inspect accessibility tree; give each link a unique descriptive name and meaningful image alt text.

wcag_reference: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 3.1.1 Language of Page
evidence: Homepage contains English content and multiple sections. Document language, heading order and landmarks are not verifiable from indexed text.
user_impact: Assistive technology may mispronounce content or make page navigation difficult.
recommended_fix: Verify html lang, header/nav/main/footer landmarks and sequential headings.

evidence: A fraud-alert announcement appears in homepage text. Dynamic behavior and live-region semantics are unknown.
user_impact: Users of assistive technology may miss updates or hear repeated announcements.
recommended_fix: Inspect whether the alert is static or dynamically injected; use live-region semantics only when appropriate.

evidence: Homepage lists Grievance Management, PLI Portal, IPPB and other service destinations. New-tab behavior needs direct verification.
user_impact: Unexpected context changes can disorient users.
recommended_fix: Review external links and announce new-tab behavior in visible text or accessible names when applicable.
